notes: Primary: Sony Computer Entertainment's own SCPH-70000 instruction-manual PDF (PDF metadata Author 'Sony Computer Entertainment Inc.', title 'SCPH-70000'), retrieved as the archive.org copy (item ja-scph-70000-cb-web); text extracted with macOS PDFKit. Axes labelled (幅×高さ×奥行き): width 230, height 28, depth 152. Sony's 2004-09-21 release gives the same 230 (W) × 28 (H) × 152 (D) mm and 900 g for every region (sources 7 and 8).

ports = the manual's 主な仕様 front and rear input/output rows, complete for the Japanese model. The North American SCPH-70011/70012 add a modem LINE connector (RJ-11), which has no §3 kind (the release: 'come with built-in modem port in addition to Ethernet port'). The controller connector is Sony's own (Sony names it 'Controller port' / コントローラ端子 and no standard); it is filed as controller_proprietary. Sony's table says 'USB' without naming the receptacle; it is filed as usb_a, the only USB receptacle in the §3 vocabulary before USB-C, and the reader should treat the A as Sony-unstated. The DC inlet is 'DC IN 8.5V' fed by an external AC adaptor; Sony does not name the plug, so features.power_inlet stays null.

media and controls = the manual's 各部のなまえ (part names, front and rear): one ディスクカバー (disc cover, filed disc_lid), one OPEN button (filed eject_button) and one combined (on/standby)/RESET button, filed as one power_button (it is also the reset; no separate reset_button exists).
released = the Japanese date in Sony's release; North America and Europe were November 1, 2004. external_ids: Wikidata Q6078262 ('slim model of the PlayStation 2'); no IGDB id on it.
